sens_en: to correct, to straighten, to feign
origine_fr: La flèche 矢 à gauche : au départ, un outil pour redresser les flèches. À droite, 乔 donnait le son, mais il se lit aujourd'hui qiáo. Redresser une flèche, c'est corriger, 矫正.
origine_en: An arrow, 矢, on the left: at first a tool for straightening arrows. On the right, 乔 gave the sound, but today it is read qiáo. Straightening an arrow is correcting, 矫正.

phrase.fr: Il se fait redresser les dents.
phrase.en: He is having his teeth straightened.
